queries:
WITH equipment_averages AS (
    SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_humidity
    FROM scanenvironment
    GROUP BY equipref
),
all_equipment_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS mean_humidity
    FROM equipment_averages
),
above_average AS (
    SELECT ea.equipref, ea.avg_humidity, am.mean_humidity
    FROM equipment_averages AS ea
    CROSS JOIN all_equipment_mean AS am
    WHERE ea.avg_humidity > am.mean_humidity
),
group_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS mean_humidity
    FROM above_average
)
SELECT
    aa.equipref,
    aa.avg_humidity,
    aa.avg_humidity - aa.mean_humidity AS above_all_equipment_mean,
    aa.avg_humidity - gm.mean_humidity AS difference_from_group_mean
FROM above_average AS aa
CROSS JOIN group_mean AS gm
WHERE aa.mean_humidity IS NOT NULL
  AND gm.mean_humidity IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY difference_from_group_mean DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

WITH equipment_averages AS (
    SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_humidity
    FROM scanenvironment
    GROUP BY equipref
),
all_equipment AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS overall_avg
    FROM equipment_averages
),
above_average AS (
    SELECT e.equipref, e.avg_humidity, a.overall_avg
    FROM equipment_averages AS e
    CROSS JOIN all_equipment AS a
    WHERE e.avg_humidity > a.overall_avg
),
group_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS group_avg
    FROM above_average
)
SELECT
    e.equipref,
    e.avg_humidity,
    e.avg_humidity - e.overall_avg AS above_overall_avg,
    e.avg_humidity - g.group_avg AS above_group_avg
FROM above_average AS e
CROSS JOIN group_average AS g
WHERE e.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
  AND g.group_avg IS NOT NULL
  AND e.avg_humidity > g.group_avg
ORDER BY above_group_avg DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

WITH equipment_averages AS (
    SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_humidity
    FROM scanenvironment
    GROUP BY equipref
),
all_equipment AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS overall_avg
    FROM equipment_averages
),
above_average AS (
    SELECT ea.equipref, ea.avg_humidity, a.overall_avg
    FROM equipment_averages AS ea
    CROSS JOIN all_equipment AS a
    WHERE ea.avg_humidity > a.overall_avg
),
group_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS group_avg
    FROM above_average
)
SELECT
    aa.equipref,
    aa.avg_humidity,
    aa.avg_humidity - aa.overall_avg AS above_overall_avg,
    aa.avg_humidity - ga.group_avg AS difference_from_group_avg
FROM above_average AS aa
CROSS JOIN group_average AS ga
WHERE aa.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
  AND ga.group_avg IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ABS(aa.avg_humidity - ga.group_avg) DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

WITH equipment_averages AS (
    SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS average_humidity
    FROM scanenvironment
    GROUP BY equipref
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(humepct) AS mean_humidity
    FROM scanenvironment
),
above_average AS (
    SELECT e.equipref, e.average_humidity, o.mean_humidity
    FROM equipment_averages AS e
    CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o
    WHERE e.average_humidity > o.mean_humidity
),
group_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_humidity) AS mean_humidity
    FROM above_average
)
SELECT
    a.equipref,
    a.average_humidity,
    a.average_humidity - a.mean_humidity AS above_overall_average,
    a.average_humidity - g.mean_humidity AS difference_from_group_mean
FROM above_average AS a
CROSS JOIN group_average AS g
WHERE a.mean_humidity IS NOT NULL
  AND g.mean_humidity IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY difference_from_group_mean DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
